context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixed infinite loading bug in premium pages. The bug was caused by early return without setting loading=false when accessToken was null. After fix, pages should load properly. Need to verify: 1) BikeProfilePreview shows on Your Bike page, 2) InteractiveRouteMap works on Free Ride page (web uses RouteMiniMap fallback), 3) History page shows route previews and clickable free ride cards with detail modal.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In premium pages (index.tsx, your-bike.tsx, free-ride.tsx, history.tsx), the data loading functions had an early return when headers was undefined (accessToken null) but did NOT set loading state to false
reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate directly to /premium or /premium/your-bike without being logged in
2. Or navigate after login when auth state hasn't fully bootstrapped
3. The page shows infinite loading spinner because loading state never becomes false
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added setLoading(false) before the early return in all affected files
